GOAL

Then, I move the maximum number of incomplete tasks from my Inbox to the "Today's Goal" project. The maximum here is assuming I work back-to-back as per my schedule and I find time for the left overs from the current day first. I am busy tonight, please do it for me. Note that the moved tasks must be identical to the original ones.
